title: Advanced Algorithms and Complexity
text:
Coming Up — Aug-Dec 2026



This course will be offered in the upcoming semester. Details will be posted closer to the start.
This postgraduate course covers state-of-the-art algorithmic paradigms, randomized algorithms, approximation algorithms, and computational complexity theory.

title: Advanced Algorithms and Complexity
text:
Target Audience
Postgraduate students and advanced undergraduates with a strong theoretical computer science background.

title: Advanced Algorithms and Complexity
text:
Prerequisites
Design and Analysis of Algorithms (CS F364) or equivalent.
